game_title: Fallback: Type Sorter – Ash Rim Trail
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must hold off lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling ore chunks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: In Ash Rim Trail, repeat each round: Sort falling ore chunks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Then check sorted_ok and advance.
player_objective: Protect the forge anvil from lava imps in Ash Rim Trail: keep sorted_ok above zero until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 2, Level 1, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

Press SPACE to run a code fix when the meter drops.
Look at the code: type(3.5)  # float
Survive for 24 seconds to complete the level.
